purpose: Test whether below-ground reserve/clonal state predicts future quantitative meadow stability beyond current above-ground state, without using binary reappearance as a recovery endpoint.

eligibility.sampling_frame: Attempt census-oriented sampling of all contemporaneously baseline-Thalassia-positive stable fixed-transect nodes in the three core bays, subject to permission and the frozen destructive-sampling geometry. The historical planning count is not a cap.

recent_2023_2025_feasibility_context.boundary: Opened historical state is used only for prospective field feasibility. Contemporaneous baseline eligibility must be re-evaluated before coring.

eligibility.below_precision_gate: If fewer than 30 analyzable baseline-Thalassia-positive nodes remain, or any core bay contributes fewer than 8, report the frozen prospective coefficient and uncertainty as a pilot. Do not use a null result to reject the below-ground reserve hypothesis.
eligibility.selection_rule: Do not subsample nodes by past decline class if all eligible nodes can be sampled. If field capacity is lower than the census frame, freeze a response-independent node list and alternates before coring; future outcome must never enter node selection.
eligibility.destructive_sampling_boundary: Cores are taken adjacent to, not directly on, permanent meter marks unless the monitoring authority explicitly permits otherwise.

destructive_sampling_guardrail.principle: Below-ground measurement must not materially alter the permanent monitoring unit whose future state is the response.
destructive_sampling_guardrail.transect_buffer: Freeze a minimum perpendicular offset from the permanent transect line before the first core; never core on a permanent meter mark or inside the routine monitoring footprint.
destructive_sampling_guardrail.core_footprint: Freeze core diameter, depth and maximum total disturbed area per node before sampling; do not enlarge cores after inspecting TNC yield.
destructive_sampling_guardrail.restoration: Backfill/restore each core hole under the monitoring authority's protocol and record any visible disturbance at the end of sampling.
destructive_sampling_guardrail.node_specific_deviation: Any safety/access/permit exception must be documented at collection and cannot depend on future response.

primary_predictor.name: rhizome_total_nonstructural_carbohydrate
primary_predictor.unit: mg g-1 dry mass under one frozen analytical protocol
primary_predictor.definition: sum of separately quantified rhizome soluble non-structural carbohydrates and starch
primary_predictor.tissue: one frozen horizontal-rhizome tissue class; exact ontogenetic/segment rule fixed after a response-independent tissue-mass pilot and before first outcome-bearing field sample
primary_predictor.direction: higher reserve predicts less subsequent quantitative decline

secondary_predictors: optional clonal/genet continuity if a validated molecular design is feasible
leaf nitrogen and phosphorus status collected contemporaneously as a nutrient-state diagnostic
baseline_new_measurements.replication: At least 3 independent adjacent below-ground cores per node; summarize the primary predictor by node median before future outcome access.

analytical_standardization.rationale: Seagrass NSC estimates are strongly method-dependent; soluble sugars and starch must not be mixed across extraction/assay methods.
analytical_standardization.preferred_assay: HPLC-based standardized seagrass NSC workflow, with soluble NSC and starch quantified separately and then summed for TNC.
analytical_standardization.reference: Sørensen et al. 2018 Aquatic Botany 151:71-79, DOI 10.1016/j.aquabot.2018.08.006
analytical_standardization.species_matrix_pilot: Before the first outcome-bearing field sample, run a response-independent Thalassia tissue pilot to verify adequate dry mass, extraction recovery, dilution range and assay precision under the chosen HPLC workflow. The pilot may optimize laboratory handling only; it cannot inspect a future biological response.
analytical_standardization.prohibited_switch: Do not switch between colorimetric and HPLC assays, extraction solvents, starch hydrolysis methods, dry/fresh-mass basis or primary sugar definition after future response access.

temporal_standardization.rationale: Thalassia rhizome soluble carbohydrate has strong seasonal variation, including reported fall maxima and spring minima.
temporal_standardization.campaign_window: Collect all primary TNC samples within one predeclared <=28-day seasonal campaign.
temporal_standardization.baseline_alignment: Primary-eligible TNC collection must occur within 14 days before or after the corresponding baseline fixed-transect survey.
temporal_standardization.time_metadata: Record exact collection date/time for every core. Do not post-hoc choose a narrower date or time-of-day subset based on future response.
temporal_standardization.failure_rule: Samples outside the frozen baseline-alignment window are excluded from the confirmatory primary analysis and may be reported descriptively only.

historical_feasibility.interpretation: Historical routine monitoring dates are too dispersed to provide a 30-node synchronized TNC baseline by passive add-on sampling.

baseline_survey_plan.preferred: Perform the fixed-transect baseline survey and TNC coring on the same day at each node.
baseline_survey_plan.hard_alignment: TNC coring must remain within +/-14 days of the paired baseline fixed-transect survey.
baseline_survey_plan.synchronization: Complete all confirmatory node pairs within one <=28-day campaign.
baseline_survey_plan.routine_schedule_boundary: If the routine monitoring calendar cannot meet the frozen timing window, conduct a dedicated additional baseline fixed-transect survey using the same quantitative protocol rather than widening the TNC campaign.
baseline_survey_plan.protocol_equivalence: The dedicated baseline must use the same meter-mark/frequency and Braun-Blanquet definitions needed for the future change endpoint.

nutrient_state_diagnostic.motivation: In Florida Thalassia, rhizome carbohydrate can covary negatively with leaf nutrient content; high carbohydrate may represent reserve storage or passive accumulation under growth limitation.
nutrient_state_diagnostic.role: Secondary interpretation diagnostic only. The primary TNC coefficient is not replaced by a nutrient-adjusted result.
nutrient_state_diagnostic.interpretation_boundary: A supported TNC-future-state association is evidence that measured reserve state is predictive; it is not by itself proof that carbohydrate causally buffers stress.

core_replication_boundary.within_node_cores: spatial measurement replicates used to estimate node-level below-ground state
core_replication_boundary.genetic_boundary: Do not count separate cores as independent genets. Thalassia genets can extend across meters to much larger distances, and connected ramets may be physiologically integrated.
core_replication_boundary.optional_genotyping: If a validated molecular clonal-identity design is added before outcome access, use it as secondary mechanism context; it does not multiply the primary sample size.

core_spatial_design.primary_rule: If >=3 contemporaneously Thalassia-positive meter marks exist, choose three observed marks nearest q25/q50/q75 site_m with unique anchors where possible.
core_spatial_design.two_mark_fallback: Use one anchor at each positive mark; place the third independent core at a separately frozen lateral/perpendicular offset from the midpoint-nearest positive mark.
core_spatial_design.one_mark_fallback: Place three independent non-overlapping offset cores adjacent to the single positive mark.
core_spatial_design.inference_unit: stable transect node; cores are within-node measurement replication and spatial sampling, not independent inferential units
core_spatial_design.prohibited_rescue: Do not relocate anchors after TNC assay results or future outcome access.

genet_identity_diagnostic.role: secondary interpretation diagnostic; cannot replace or rescue the primary rhizome-TNC test
genet_identity_diagnostic.sampling: Preserve one DNA-quality tissue aliquot corresponding to each of the three frozen TNC core anchors before biochemical processing.
genet_identity_diagnostic.marker_rule: Use one validated Thalassia testudinum multilocus genotyping panel frozen before laboratory genotyping. Published nuclear microsatellite panels are acceptable if locus performance is verified in Tampa material; a validated SNP panel may replace them only if frozen before any future outcome access.
node_summary: number of distinct multilocus genotypes among the three anchors
whether any multilocus genotype repeats across spatial anchors
maximum along-transect separation among anchors sharing a multilocus genotype

interpretation.all_distinct: Do not describe node-scale reserve persistence as evidence of one integrated clone. A TNC association remains a below-ground reserve-state result.
interpretation.repeated_genotype: Repeated multilocus genotype across anchors supports genet-scale clonality but does not prove that rhizome connections remain physically intact or that resources are currently translocated among anchors.

genet_identity_diagnostic.no_primary_interaction: Do not add TNC x clonality or clonality x future-state interactions to the primary analysis after outcome inspection. Genet information is an interpretation diagnostic unless a separately powered prospective study is frozen in advance.
references: Van Dijk & van Tussenbroek 2010 Aquatic Botany 92:63-69, DOI 10.1016/j.aquabot.2009.10.005
Bricker et al. 2015 Aquatic Botany 123:76-82, DOI 10.1016/j.aquabot.2015.01.008
Van Dijk et al. 2016 Heredity, limited pollen/seed dispersal and large genets in Thalassia testudinum

future_outcome.primary: next fixed-transect survey focal_frequency minus baseline focal_frequency
secondary: next survey Braun-Blanquet all-point index minus baseline
next survey blade length minus baseline where observed
next survey shoot density minus baseline where observed
future_outcome.rationale: Use continuous quantitative stability as the mechanism endpoint; annual detection transitions are not ecological recovery.

destructive_sampling_sensitivity.definition: Recalculate future focal frequency after excluding the fixed permanent meter mark(s) nearest the three TNC core anchors under one pre-frozen distance/mark rule.
destructive_sampling_sensitivity.purpose: Check that the prospective TNC association is not driven by local disturbance from destructive coring.
destructive_sampling_sensitivity.interpretation: Primary inference remains node-level full-transect frequency; a strong discrepancy is reported as a measurement-intervention concern rather than hidden.

primary_analysis.estimator: standardized coefficient of baseline rhizome TNC in a prespecified linear model for future change in focal_frequency
primary_analysis.uncertainty: node-label permutation or bootstrap fixed before outcome access
primary_analysis.directional_hypothesis: higher rhizome TNC -> more positive / less negative future frequency change
primary_analysis.missing_data_rule: complete-case primary analysis; do not impute the primary below-ground predictor or add secondary traits to recover sample size.
primary_analysis.confirmatory_gate: >=30 analyzable nodes and >=8 nodes per core bay

support_rule.interval: two-sided 95% interval under the frozen node-level uncertainty procedure
support_rule.note: Do not switch to a one-sided test after observing the future response.

secondary_analysis.note: Secondary clonal traits, nutrient-state diagnostics and secondary biological outcomes are descriptive/supportive and cannot replace a null primary TNC -> future frequency result.
secondary_analysis.nutrient_diagnostic: Report TNC relationships with contemporaneous leaf N, P and N:P and one predeclared sensitivity model adding leaf nutrient status if sample coverage is adequate. This is interpretation support, not a second primary test.
secondary_analysis.component_reporting: Report soluble NSC and starch separately in addition to TNC, but do not select whichever component best predicts the future as a replacement primary endpoint.
secondary_analysis.multiple_testing: Apply one declared family correction if inferential secondary tests are retained.

meristem_bank_hypothesis.biological_idea: Below-ground persistence may depend not only on stored carbohydrate but also on regenerative meristem / rhizome-apex capacity, analogous to a dormant bud or meristem bank.
meristem_bank_hypothesis.predictor: predeclared node-level rhizome meristem/apex density from the same standardized below-ground sampling frame
meristem_bank_hypothesis.outcome: future quantitative focal-frequency and/or shoot-density change under one predeclared corrected secondary family
meristem_bank_hypothesis.role: secondary competing below-ground mechanism, not a rescue of the TNC primary test
meristem_bank_hypothesis.interpretation: TNC and meristem density represent distinct candidate axes: energetic resistance versus regenerative capacity.

within_transect_anchor_diagnostic.eligibility: Three distinct frozen q25/q50/q75 Thalassia-positive anchors with quantitative baseline Braun-Blanquet state at all three anchors, plus valid anchor-level TNC and future meter-mark state.
within_transect_anchor_diagnostic.predictor: within_node_centered_anchor_TNC = anchor_TNC - mean(anchor_TNC across the three anchors)
within_transect_anchor_diagnostic.outcome: future Thalassia Braun-Blanquet score at the same permanent meter mark; sampled focal absence=0, present nonnumeric 'Reported'=quantitatively missing
within_transect_anchor_diagnostic.uncertainty: stable-node cluster bootstrap, resampling the full three-anchor node as one unit; code frozen before future outcome access
within_transect_anchor_diagnostic.role: Secondary diagnostic of local reserve information after stable transect identity is removed. It cannot replace or rescue the node-level primary TNC result.
within_transect_anchor_diagnostic.site_template_boundary: Support is less compatible with a purely transect-level time-invariant site-template explanation, but persistent meter-mark microhabitat and time-varying local common causes remain possible.
within_transect_anchor_diagnostic.intervention_boundary: Anchor-level inference is valid only when the frozen core offset keeps destructive sampling outside the permanent meter-mark monitoring footprint.

claim_boundary: Prospective observational mechanism test; even a supported result does not by itself prove causal clonal buffering.
Do not use binary re-recording as a recovery outcome.
Do not change the primary clonal predictor after future response access.
Do not replace a null primary result with a secondary clonal trait.
If below-ground sampling is not independent of monitoring state or management intervention, document that selection explicitly.
Rhizome TNC is seasonally variable; do not pool samples from an unconstrained seasonal window and call the differences stable clonal reserve.
High TNC is not automatically a health score because carbohydrate can accumulate when growth is nutrient-limited; contemporaneous nutrient status is an interpretation diagnostic.
Within-node core replication reduces TNC measurement error but does not substitute for node-level replication.
If the 30-node / 8-per-bay precision gate fails, a null result is a pilot null and cannot reject the reserve-buffering hypothesis.
Within-node cores are measurement replicates, not independent clone/genet replicates.
A secondary meristem/apex signal may support regenerative capacity as a distinct below-ground mechanism, but it cannot replace a null primary TNC result.
Three cores are within-node measurement replication/spatial coverage; inferential replication remains the stable transect node.

Because coring is destructive, the sampling footprint is treated as a potential intervention; any evidence that local core disturbance affected future monitoring state must be reported rather than interpreted as reserve ecology.
TNC is the primary below-ground reserve measurement, not a direct measure of genet size or physiological integration.

Identical multilocus genotypes across anchors establish genet identity only; fragmented ramets can share a genotype without a currently intact rhizome connection, so genetic identity is not proof of resource translocation.
Boca Ciega Bay, if sampled, is a prespecified secondary context extension; it cannot rescue a null three-bay primary result or be described as independent replication.
A supported within-transect anchor-TNC result weakens stable transect-level site-template confounding but does not eliminate fixed meter-mark microhabitat or time-varying local common causes.

design_precision_gate.planning_model_terms: TNC + baseline focal_frequency + baseline Braun-Blanquet state + two water-body indicators
design_precision_gate.planning_assumption: Approximate Gaussian multiple-regression benchmark, two-sided alpha 0.05, 80% power for the TNC term; used only to prevent an underpowered confirmatory null.
design_precision_gate.primary_rule: Confirmatory interpretation requires >=30 analyzable nodes and >=8 analyzable nodes in each core bay. Below that gate, retain the prospective estimate and uncertainty but do not interpret a null as evidence against clonal/reserve buffering.
design_precision_gate.interpretation: The realistic ~33-node frame is powered mainly for moderate-to-large partial effects; additional within-node cores improve measurement precision but do not replace node replication.

prespecified_context_extension.sampling_rule: If permissions/logistics allow, collect Boca Ciega under the same frozen <=28-day campaign, +/-14-day paired baseline, q25/q50/q75 core geometry, tissue class, HPLC, nutrient diagnostic and genet-diagnostic rules. Do not weaken any core three-bay rule to include Boca Ciega.
prespecified_context_extension.primary_boundary: The confirmatory primary mechanism test remains Old + Middle + Lower Tampa Bay under the existing >=30 total / >=8 per core-bay gate.
prespecified_context_extension.secondary_four_bay_model: future_delta_frequency ~ baseline_frequency + baseline_Braun_Blanquet + rhizome_TNC + water_body, using all eligible sampled nodes from the four prespecified bays
prespecified_context_extension.secondary_role: Context-extension sensitivity only. Report the four-bay standardized TNC coefficient and two-sided 95% interval under the same frozen uncertainty procedure.

interpretation.core_supported_four_bay_same_positive_di: Strengthens transportability of the measured reserve-state association across an additional Tampa Bay meadow context, but is not independent replication because the three core bays are reused.
interpretation.core_supported_four_bay_opposite_or_stro: Report context dependence; do not claim a bay-general reserve effect.
interpretation.core_unsupported_four_bay_supported: Does not rescue the primary mechanism test. Treat the four-bay result as secondary and hypothesis-generating.
interpretation.boca_ciega_only: Report a BCB-only coefficient/interval descriptively if estimable; n~8 is not assigned an independent confirmatory pass/fail gate.

prespecified_context_extension.exclusion_rule: If Boca Ciega cannot meet the frozen timing/assay/field rules, omit it from the context extension rather than widening windows or changing the primary three-bay design.
claim_boundary: Boca Ciega is prespecified before TNC collection and future outcome access.
The extension broadens environmental/community context and may improve precision, but it is not an independent replication dataset.
Do not add Boca Ciega after seeing a null core result as a sample-size rescue.
